interface.short_description: Answer product and business questions with data
interface.long_description:
Data Analytics helps you turn questions about your product or business into answers you can trust. Ask why a metric changed, what the data shows about where a team should focus next, how to define KPIs, whether a dataset is reliable, or how large an opportunity might be, and it can help you investigate the data and turn the findings into shareable reports, charts, dashboards, notebooks, and recommendations.

Start with the data you already have: connected warehouses, BI or product analytics tools, docs, chats, spreadsheets, uploaded files, pasted results, or clearly labeled sample data. The plugin guides you through the right workflow, checks sources where possible, and keeps the evidence visible in reviewable tables, charts, dashboards, and report apps you can share.
interface.default_prompt: Help me get started with my first data task
default_prompts: Help me get started with my first data task
Analyze product or business data and recommend where to focus next
Diagnose why a key metric changed and identify the biggest drivers

skills.name: heygen-avatar
skills.description: Create a persistent HeyGen avatar — a reusable face + voice identity for the agent, the user, or any named character — powered by HeyGen Avatar V technology. Prompt-based creation by default (description → HeyGen builds it); photo upload is optional for real-person digital twins. Use when: (1) giving the agent a face + voice so it can present videos ("bring yourself to life", "create your avatar", "give yourself an avatar", "design a presenter", "set up an avatar", "let's make an avatar"), (2) the user wants to appear in videos as themselves ("create my avatar", "I want my face in a video", "digital twin of me", "build me an avatar"), (3) building a named character presenter ("create an avatar called Cleo", "design a character named X"), (4) establishing HeyGen identity before making videos — the correct FIRST step when no avatar exists yet. Chain signal: when the user says both an identity/avatar action AND a video action in the same request ("create an avatar AND make a video", "set up identity THEN create a video", "design a presenter AND immediately record"), run heygen-avatar first, then heygen-video. Returns avatar_id + voice_id — pass directly to heygen-video to create HeyGen videos. NOT for: generating videos (use heygen-video), translating videos, or TTS-only tasks.

interface.default_prompt: Create a reusable HeyGen avatar for me from a written description, then help me choose a matching voice.

skills.name: heygen-video
skills.description: Generate HeyGen presenter videos via the v3 Video Agent pipeline — handles Frame Check (aspect ratio correction), prompt engineering, avatar resolution, and voice selection. Required for any HeyGen video generation. Replaces deprecated endpoints with v3. Use when: (1) generating any HeyGen video (via API or otherwise), (2) sending a personalized video message (outreach, update, announcement, pitch, knowledge), (3) creating a HeyGen presenter-led explainer, tutorial, or product demo with a human face, (4) "make a video of me saying...", "send a video to my leads", "record an update for my team", "create a video pitch", "make a loom-style message", "I want to appear in this video", "generate a HeyGen video", "make a talking head video". Accepts avatar_id from heygen-avatar for identity-first HeyGen videos, or uses a stock presenter. Returns video share URL + HeyGen session URL for iteration. Chain signal: when the user wants to create/design an avatar AND make a video in the same request, run heygen-avatar first, then return here. Conjunctions to watch: "and then", "and immediately", "first...then", "X and make a video", "design [presenter] and record" = always CHAIN. If the user provides a photo AND wants a video, route to heygen-avatar first. NOT for: avatar creation or identity setup (use heygen-avatar first), cinematic footage or b-roll without a presenter, translating videos, TTS-only, or streaming avatars.

release.description:
12andus Astrology delivers professional-grade astrological insights powered by precise calculations and personalized charts analysis.

What You Can Explore

Personality & Psychological Insights
Discover your strengths, challenges, emotional patterns, and inner motivations based on your unique birth chart. Understand how you think, love, work, and
make decisions through the lens of your planetary placements.

Timing Guidance & Forecasts
Receive personalized transit forecasts for up to one year ahead, revealing upcoming periods of growth, change, opportunity, or challenge. See when
key planetary influences begin and end.

Relationship Compatibility
Explore the dynamics between you and anyone else through synastry analysis (how your charts interact) and composite charts (the unique energy your
relationship creates together). For romantic relationships, understand the chemistry of attraction, emotional compatibility, communication styles, intimacy patterns, and long-term potential. The same depth of analysis applies to any relationship — family bonds, friendships, business partnerships, or professional collaborations. See where you naturally harmonize, where friction may arise, and how to navigate differences with greater awareness.

Relationship Timing
Go beyond static compatibility — see how transiting planets activate your composite chart, revealing the best times for important relationship milestones,
conversations, or decisions.

- Private Birth Data Storage — Securely save up to 50 birth charts under your account for instant access to readings without re-entering data
- Birth Charts — Complete natal analysis including planets, houses, aspects, and retrograde positions
- Transit Charts — Forecasts from 1 day to 365 days showing active planetary influences
- Relationship Charts — Synastry and composite analysis between any two saved people
- Relationship Forecasts — Transits to composite charts revealing relationship timing

Unmatched Precision
12andus calculations consider the exact planetary positions based on your specific birth date, time, and place. When birth time is unknown, the system adapts intelligently, providing insights without house-dependent data.

Holistic Readings
Unlike fragmented interpretations that list placements one by one, 12andus synthesizes your chart holistically — weaving together planetary positions, aspects, and houses into a unified narrative that reflects how these energies actually work together in your life.

release.description:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."

Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."

Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."

Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."

release.description:
Jam for ChatGPT connects your Jam screen recordings to ChatGPT. When you paste a Jam link, the app pulls in rich debugging context from that recording, including video, user events, console logs, errors, and network requests. ChatGPT can then use this data to help you understand, fix, and organize product issues.

Use Jam for ChatGPT to:
• Explain what went wrong in a recording and why
• Turn a Jam into an engineering ready bug ticket
• Write test cases based on the exact user steps
• Summarize a customer’s experience and impact
• Group similar Jams into themes or issue clusters
• Plan code changes based on real traces, not guesses

How it works:
1. Record an issue or user session with Jam.
2. Copy the Jam link, for example https://jam.dev/c/UUID.
3. In ChatGPT, paste the Jam URL and ask what you want to do, such as:
        •        “Find the root cause of this bug.”
        •        “Write a Jira ticket from this Jam.”
        •        “List clean reproduction steps from this recording.”
        •        “Group these Jam links into related issues.”

Behind the scenes, the Jam app turns your Jam into structured, machine readable data that ChatGPT can work with. You get deep technical context and clear next steps, without retyping steps or relying on users to copy and paste logs.

If you work in engineering, product, QA, or support, Jam for ChatGPT helps you move from “What happened here?” to “Here is exactly what we need to do next.”

release.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.

To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.

release.description:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

7. Compare quarterly profits: "Check the profit for this quarter, compare it to last quarter, and provide a breakdown by department"
8. Generate cash flow reports: "Could you provide a cash flow report for the last 30 days, including all incoming and outgoing transactions?"
9. Review accounts receivable: "Share the current accounts receivable status and tell me how many overdue invoices we have and which customers owe the most"

release.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

release.description:
Factagora — Explore Truth Through Interactive Argument Graphs

Don't just get an answer — see how it was reached.

Factagora turns claims and predictions into interactive knowledge graphs where adversarial AI agents debate opposing viewpoints and generate transparent verdicts. Each node represents a claim, piece of evidence, or argument; each connection shows how they relate. Click through the graph to understand the reasoning behind every conclusion.

What you get:
• Verdicts — TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN with confidence scores from adversarial AI debate
• Evidence — Credibility-scored sources supporting or opposing the claim
• AI Debate — Multiple AI agents (Skeptic, Analyst, Optimist) argue their positions with cited reasoning
• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"

skills.description: Prepare an LP to meet with their fund manager (GP): review the fund's latest reporting, surface what changed since last period, and draft the questions worth raising. Use when someone is getting ready for a manager call, quarterly check-in, annual meeting, LPAC meeting, or a re-up decision — for example "I have my quarterly call with this manager next week, help me prep," "what changed in this fund this quarter," "what should I ask them about these marks," or "what are the red flags in this reporting package." Draws on Chronograph fund and portfolio data when connected — captured reporting such as fund performance, schedules of investments, and portfolio company KPI profiles — and asks the LP to provide anything else it needs, such as a capital account statement, investor letter, or AGM or board deck.

skills.name: chronograph-portfolio-company-one-pager
skills.description: GP platform one-pager and investor report generator for private equity portfolio companies. Use this skill whenever a user asks to generate a company tearsheet, one-pager, investor report, portfolio overview, or company deep-dive — especially when they name a company or ask to "build a report", "create a one-pager", or "show me a tearsheet". Also trigger when the user asks to include commentary, quarterly updates, investment narratives, or any Investment Overview in the report output. This skill handles live data fetching via a connected MCP data source OR from an uploaded Excel model, metric formatting, AI-generated or model-sourced commentary, and rendering a fully styled HTML one-pager. Also trigger for LP quarterly updates, valuation summaries, and portco performance pages — any output that combines financials, valuation, and return data for a single portfolio company.

interface.short_description: Generate styled HTML GP one-pagers and LP quarterly updates for portfolio companies

release.description:
PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics.
The unique angle is correlation. PagePulse tracks every detected change to your pages — title rewrites, content updates, schema edits, link changes — and scores each one by importance. So when you ask "why did traffic drop on the pricing page last week?", ChatGPT can pull the analytics, surface the relevant page changes, and show you which edits lined up with the shift.
Use it to investigate traffic dips, audit what's been changing across your site, find the queries driving impressions to a specific page, browse pages by tag, or get a quick read on how a project is performing — without switching between dashboards.

This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment.

Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

release.description:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

1. 아모레퍼시픽 브랜드 직영 쇼핑과 신뢰할 수 있는 배송
설화수, 헤라, 이니스프리, 에뛰드 등 아모레퍼시픽의 모든 브랜드를 가장 빠르게 만나보세요. 본사 직영 공식몰로서 100% 정품 보장은 물론, 신상품 단독 혜택과 안전한 직배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 본사가 직접 보증하는 신뢰도 높은 쇼핑 환경에서 안심하고 제품을 선택할 수 있습니다.

2. 풍성한 쇼핑 지원과 차별화된 멤버십 플러스
매월 업데이트되는 등급별 할인 쿠폰과 무료 배송/반품 서비스로 스마트한 소비를 도와드립니다. 특히 가입비 이상의 포인트 페이백과 프리미엄 사은품, 기프트카드를 제공하는 '멤버십플러스'를 통해 압도적인 체감 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다. 활동할수록 높아지는 쇼핑 등급에 따라 제공되는 프리미엄 라운지 경품 등 다채로운 혜택을 경험해 보세요.

3. 스킨노트와 뷰티피드로 완성하는 맞춤형 피부 관리

release.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

release.description:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

release.description:
Most budgeting tools show you your balance as it is today.

But in real life, money doesn't work that way.
Salaries arrive later. Bills are already scheduled. Credit card payments appear days after you spend.

This means the number you see in your account is often not the number you actually have.

Simply Family Budget helps you understand your real balance by taking future bills, shared expenses, and timing into account.

Instead of focusing on what you have right now, it helps you see what your money will look like over time.

It's especially useful for families managing money across multiple accounts, cards, and responsibilities, where things rarely line up neatly.

The goal isn't to track everything.
It's to make your financial situation feel clear and predictable.

release.description:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

release.description:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.

release.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

interface.long_description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

release.description:
TrailVerse brings your universe of national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

Deep live data for 470+ US national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning for any US destination, including state parks, cities, beaches, and road trips. Tell Trailie you're a beginner with kids visiting Zion in July, and it can steer you toward family-friendly trails, flag timed-entry and permit requirements, and build a pace-matched plan grounded in live NPS alerts and weather. Always confirm safety-critical details on NPS.gov before you go.

Five focused capabilities:

• Plan a trip — Constraint-aware day-by-day itineraries with confidence scoring. Post-validates plans for fitness level, family pacing, and feasibility. Works for NPS sites and beyond (state parks, cities, mixed road trips). Two voices: The Planner (structured, thorough) or The Local (casual, opinionated insider picks).

• Park details — Rich live info for NPS sites: current weather, 5-day forecast when available, active alerts, entrance fees, and top activities.

• Compare parks — Side-by-side 2–4 NPS parks with auto-computed highlights: best overall, warmest right now, and lower-crowd option.

• Search parks — Find NPS sites by state, activity, or free-text query across the full catalog.

• Find events — Upcoming ranger programs, guided tours, and park-hosted events at NPS sites.

Read tools pull from the official National Park Service API and live weather; itineraries run through TrailVerse's constraint validation pipeline. Free to use in ChatGPT with generous limits on park lookup tools. For saved trips, PDF export, the visual Plan Workspace, and your full Trailie history, continue free at nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai.

PDF4me delivers an intelligent and efficient solution for all your PDFs.
Boost your productivity with PDF4me: access crucial data, make edits, and convert files to PDFs directly —all in ChatGPT. From single-document conversion to mega data files, PDF4me is there.

Key Features:
- Compress PDF: Reduce PDF file sizes with customizable compression options.
- Convert to PDF: Convert Doc, PPT's and excel files into PDFs.

Future Features:
- Watermark: Add text or image watermarks to your documents.
- Split PDF: Break down large PDFs into smaller, more manageable files.
- Extract Text and Images: Retrieve text and images from your PDFs with ease.
- Merge PDF: Combine multiple PDFs into a single document in your preferred order.
- Image to PDF: Convert up to 200 images (JPG or PNG) into PDF format.
- Organise PDF: Re-arrange, re-order, or remove pages from your PDFs.
- PDF to Word/Excel/PowerPoint
- Sign PDF: Create and add digital signatures to your documents.
- PDF Viewer / Editor: View and edit PDFs directly, adding text, notes, or stamps.
- Optimise for Web: Make PDFs web-ready with linearization for efficient streaming.
- Prepare for Print:
- PDF Metadata: View and edit metadata, including author, keywords, and copyright information.
- Flatten PDF: Converts interactive elements (forms, annotations, and layers) into a static image or text, preventing further editing.
- Add Page Numbers: Inserts sequential numbers on each page of the PDF.
- Redact PDF: Permanently removes or blackouts sensitive information from the document.
- Find and Replace: Searches for specific text and replaces it with new text or redacts it.
- Merge PDF Overlay: Combines two PDFs (useful for adding watermarks, stamps, or templates).
- Optimise PDF: Improves usability, security and performance.
- Repair PDF: Fixes corrupted or damaged PDFs, resolving issues like missing content, unreadable text, or broken formatting.
- Protect PDF: Adds security features such as password protection, encryption, or restrictions.

release.description:

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

release.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

release.description:

Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.

release.description:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.

release.description: Learn durable Codex preferences from session feedback and retain them as scoped, reviewable AGENTS.md improvements.

interface.long_description: When using Codex, we often see it miss things that feel obvious to us: it may run far more tests than necessary or make assumptions about a project that simply do not make sense. Correcting it helps in the current conversation, but that lesson is often forgotten as soon as a new conversation begins. A good harness should keep learning a user's taste, preferences, and working style from these interactions. This Skill does exactly that: it analyzes Codex conversation history, extracts durable preferences, and writes them to project-level or global AGENTS.md files, giving Codex a form of continuous learning. You can think of it as a stripped-down version of Hermes. The project intentionally limits itself to preferences suitable for AGENTS.md rather than trying to generate Skills. We do not want to lock an agent into particular ways of working, since such constraints can become liabilities as models improve. User preferences, by contrast, are not learned simply by upgrading the model and are therefore worth preserving.
interface.default_prompt: Review my conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
default_prompts: Review my conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
Review new conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
Schedule a daily 10:00 AM task to mine new conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.

Use when asked to optimize Codex behavior memory, review or withdraw learned AGENTS.md rules, run incremental daily AGENTS memory maintenance, or configure that maintenance as a scheduled task. Do not use to mine workflow Skills or rewrite unowned AGENTS.md content.

release.description:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.

release.description:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.

release.description:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.

release.description:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.

release.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

release.description: Turn complex work into inspectable, verified execution graphs.

interface.long_description:
Graph Mode turns complex tasks into transparent, dependency-aware execution graphs instead of relying on an open-ended agent loop.

It breaks work into explicit nodes with dependencies, access levels, expected outputs, evidence requirements, attempt limits, and clear statuses. Graph Mode can run independent research or inspection branches in parallel, safely join their results, verify completion with deterministic evidence, and perform one bounded repair cycle when verification fails.

Use it for repository audits, feature implementation, parallel research, maker-reviewer workflows, monitoring, and other multi-step tasks where control flow and proof of completion matter.

Graph Mode does not expand the user’s permissions or scope. External writes, destructive actions, and materially ambiguous decisions remain approval-gated. Every run ends with a clear terminal state and reports the executed path, evidence, changes, blockers, skipped branches, and remaining uncertainty.

release.description:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

release.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

release.description:
KMath Student is your daily math practice coach inside ChatGPT. Every day it prepares a focused set of problems matched to your current chapter and skill level — and instead of handing you the answer, it walks you through guided, step-by-step hints until you solve it yourself.

When you get stuck, the assistant explains the underlying concept and points you to the next step. Questions you miss are queued automatically for follow-up practice, so weak spots get addressed without busywork. A built-in diagnostic exam finds your starting point, and as you finish each chapter, the system recommends the next one based on your progress.

The full daily-practice experience runs on the Free plan in seven languages — English, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Thai. An optional Premium subscription, available separately on the KMath website, unlocks higher daily limits.

Built for middle and high school students who want a steady, hint-first way to get better at math — one problem at a time.

release.description:
Lott Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the region stretching from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in northwestern Germany.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. With extensive local market expertise and personalized advice, Lott Immobilien combines innovative digital solutions with many years of experience in the regional real estate market.

Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation across the region from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg
Better understanding of property locations, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different cities and municipalities

Direct access to experienced real estate professionals

release.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

release.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

release.description: Open-source full-SDLC framework with graph-native project knowledge for agentic development.

interface.long_description:
NaCl (reading as Natrium Chloride) is an open-source full-SDLC framework, and its core innovation is how it solves the hardest problem in agentic development: storing and retrieving project knowledge. Instead of markdown specs that agents must re-read every session, all project knowledge — requirements, architecture decisions, entities, rules, and their relationships — lives in a Neo4j knowledge graph as first-class queryable objects. The measured effect: planning a single use case takes ~550 tokens (one targeted Cypher query) instead of ~150,000 tokens (reading a ~70-file markdown spec, because the agent doesn't know in advance where the relevant facts live) — a 99.6% reduction in context per use case, repeated in every planning session.

Around the graph we've built the full tooling for agentic development and testing: 57 skills covering BA → SA → TDD development → review → QA → release, quality gates before production, and an autonomous goal orchestrator (/nacl-goal). The framework answers "how is this built and why" for any part of the system, regardless of project scale or iteration count. Benchmarked on a real production project (EV charging station management): a classical team was estimated at 5,831 person-hours; running fully on NaCl the same scope takes 1,480 person-hours — 4x fewer person-hours and 60% lower cost.

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.

release.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

release.description:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable

release.description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
