release.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.

release.description:
Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

The mobile app keeps your travel record up to date in the background, shows where you have been on a map and helps you stay ahead of tax residency, Schengen 90/180, visa and time-away limits, custom limits, alerts, tax signals and days needing review.

In ChatGPT, you can ask plain-English questions about your Roam Rule record before booking a trip, checking a Schengen stay, preparing for an adviser call or setting up a regular check-in. Ask about logged countries, current counters, upcoming thresholds and unresolved travel days, then get a quick visual summary of what needs attention next.

With Roam Rule in ChatGPT you can:

- check where your travel days are adding up before booking a trip
- ask what to review before another Schengen or visa-sensitive journey
- use a planned itinerary in the conversation to ask what counters you should check first
- prepare a quick summary before speaking to an accountant, adviser or immigration professional
- set a regular ChatGPT check-in to remind you to review your Roam Rule counters and days needing attention

release.description:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux box, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage systemd services, read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and Linux file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple servers and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit nginx configs, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

release.description:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.
For people, it offers readable pages about skincare questions, ingredients, products, concerns, side effects, cited sources, and product comparisons. For AI assistants, it provides read-only MCP access to the same public knowledge structure, so answers can include canonical SkinKnowledgeBase URLs, citations where available, product facts, ingredient context, comparison caveats, and clear uncertainty when source information is limited.
SkinKnowledgeBase is designed for transparent cosmetic-skincare reference, not medical advice. It avoids fake ratings, paid rankings, guaranteed outcomes, and unsupported “best overall” claims. It is useful for shoppers, researchers, content teams, and AI assistants that need grounded skincare context instead of vague beauty claims.

release.description:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within ChatGPT. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.

release.description:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results — FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV — in interactive viewers
* Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.

release.description:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

release.description: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.

release.description:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

release.description:
Book ferry tickets, longtail boats, speedboats, snorkeling trips, and island tours across Thailand — directly in ChatGPT and social chat channels like WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, and Facebook Messenger. No forms, no redirects to a website. Just tell the app where you want to go and when, confirm the option you like, and get your ticket by email.
Covers 50+ destinations and 40+ local boat operators, including Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, Bangkok, Phi Phi, Phuket, Krabi, Koh Lanta, and Koh Lipe — plus access to every island in Thailand. release.description:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

release.description:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

release.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

release.description:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.

release.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

release.description:
Autumn lets hotel operators ask about their property's performance, pricing, bookings, and marketing — and get answers straight from their own data.

Once you connect your Autumn account, you can ask things like:
- "How is occupancy for next month compared to last year?"
- "What are my ADR and RevPAR this quarter?"
- "Which room types look underpriced right now?"
- "Who were my top-spending guests last month?"
- "How did my Google Ads perform last week?"

Autumn pulls live data from your property management system (Mews, Cloudbeds, or ResNexus), your rate plans, your Google Ads account, and review sites like Google, Booking.com, and Expedia — so the answers reflect what's actually happening at your property today.

All tools are read-only. Autumn does not change rates, modify bookings, or write anything back to your PMS.

Requires an active Autumn subscription. You'll authorize access to your Autumn workspace via OAuth on first use.

Write in 50+ languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean and more, and improve your foreign-language skills every day.

Write as much as you can in the foreign-languages. The AI assistant provides real-time corrections with perfect grammar.
Feeling hesitant to start writing in a foreign language? It’s perfectly fine to mix in your native language. The AI engine automatically translates it into natural, context-appropriate foreign-language sentences.

Even rough drafts are polished smoothly, the “Blossom Editor” helps you write in any language with ease.
Hundreds of thousands of foreign-language journal entries are updated daily on Blossom.

Blossom is the world’s first and largest AI language-learning platform that integrates journaling with AI, allowing daily diary writing to naturally turn into language learning.
With just one sentence a day, you can build a habit that covers all core language skills — writing, speaking, listening, and reading.

With a single global journal written together with AI each day, you get vocabulary study, shadowing, AI tutor conversations, and more. Every language learning feature made possible through journaling.

Join global Blossom users and record and share your daily life in a foreign language.

✨ AI Tools
• Blossom AI: Ask the AI anything about language learning.
• Blossom Editor: An AI-powered writing editor with real-time feedback and grammar correction.

🎯 Learning Features
• Diary Voca: Automatically creates vocabulary lists from your journal and helps you learn words and sentences through fun games.
• Diary Speak: Improve listening and pronunciation through shadowing practice using your own journal.
• Diary Inspector: Continue daily learning with correction history and follow-up questions.
• Proofreading: Skilled tutors provide professional corrections within 24 hours.
• Level Test: Track your proficiency level based on your journal entries.

🌍 Global Community
• Shared Diaries: Decorate your journal with stickers and share your daily life with global friends around the world.
• Language Exchange: Chat with global users in real-time and make foreign friends naturally.
• Blossom Points: Earn points through community activities and exchange them for real cash.
• Blossom World Travel: Explore new cultures and everyday lives through journals written by users worldwide.

🪄 Utility / Tools
• Blossom Translate: A brand new translator that supports “AI agentic communication” for travel, customer support, and conversations with foreign friends.
• Blossom Diary: You can use Blossom like a regular diary by setting learning language to your native language. (All decoration and community features remain available!)

🌐 Learning Languages
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Khmer, Burmese, Turkish, Kazakh, Russian, Ukrainian, Mongolian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Greek, Romanian, Hungarian, Czech, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Slovenian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Icelandic, Irish, Maltese, Luxembourgish, Serbian, Catalan, Albanian, Belarusian, Bosnian, Galician, Macedonian, Basque

🌸 Blossom
Blossom (Blossom Diary) began as an English Diary and has grown into the world’s first and largest platform that integrates journaling and language learning through AI.

Enterprise Knowledge gives agents a way to query this repository during a conversation and ground their responses in your actual approved source material. It is distinct from Conversation Memory (twilio-customer-memory), which is scoped to individual end-customers and captures what you know about a specific person. The two are designed to be combined: enterprise content for business practices, customer memory for personalization.
